rubrics.justification: Generally captures a poor-quality, poorly organized embryo with indistinct ICM and sparse TE, consistent with 1DD, but it overinterprets stage by calling it very early blastocyst/full-to-expanded morula and speculates about collapse/handling not clearly evident from the image.

Integrates age, ovarian response, prior live birth, recurrent ectopics, smoking, endometrial thickness, and male factor reasonably well with embryo quality, though BMI and some sperm details are not meaningfully incorporated.

Reasoning is structured and mostly consistent: favorable patient factors are weighed against very poor embryo morphology to justify a low implantation estimate. Minor issues include speculative comments about thawing/handling and stage discrepancy.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice: poor-prognosis counseling, proceed if only embryo, luteal support, ectopic surveillance, smoking cessation, and selective rather than routine PGT-A at age 29. Some suggestions are more speculative than guideline-driven.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including monitoring for ectopic, lifestyle modification, review of cycle/lab factors, and tubal evaluation. Useful clinically, though not highly specific on transfer-day management details.
